# Exit codes

Every messq command exits 0–7 per PLAN.md section 8. Two documented
exceptions sit outside the table: `messq serve` keeps its sysexits values
`74` (storage latch), `75` (data dir locked) and `78` (config will never
work) for systemd's `RestartPreventExitStatus`, and an interrupt exits
`130` (128+SIGINT).

| Exit | Name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `ok` | success |
| 1 | `error` | generic runtime failure, incl. a bug in the daemon |
| 2 | `usage` | bad flag, bad argument, request the daemon rejected as malformed |
| 3 | `not_found` | stream / consumer / message / seq does not exist |
| 4 | `conflict` | conflict, stale fence, precondition or limit refused the request |
| 5 | `empty` | a wait expired before the request was satisfied (zero rows is still 0) |
| 6 | `unreachable` | no answer obtainable from the daemon |
| 7 | `permission` | authentication or authorization refused |
